recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If OO still wants explicit child ServiceRequest/orderDetail intent guidance, it should be raised as a new follow-up because current R6 source follows the later FHIR-47465 ServiceRequest.intent wording.
issue_request: FHIR-43343 was an Applied FHIR-core ServiceRequest issue, resolved Persuasive, asking whether child requests referenced by ServiceRequest.orderDetail should have their own status/intent or use intent 'option' so they follow the parent. The approved resolution was to add language to ServiceRequest.intent saying child ServiceRequests could default to the parent ServiceRequest's status but do not always need to.
initial_application: Jira's application comment points to commit 477f617b2c19d577af77edbfa6b7bcf7e3691630 in PR #3160. Git history shows implementation commit 783eb433327dbe01df530b96d534fd92dc50fdbf adding the child-ServiceRequests sentence to source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml, with PR merge 71e9fb098ca79a4fa239f1d081edaf7952b8f940 bringing that branch into the main history.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml current build-scope source. A later Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue, FHIR-47465, explicitly changed the ServiceRequest.intent comment from the FHIR-43343-era text, including the child-ServiceRequests sentence, to Request.intent-aligned immutability guidance with ServiceRequest-specific wording. The combined branch already has an AutoFHIR audit for FHIR-47465, and no Jira/Zulip/Confluence evidence found during this investigation required restoring the earlier child sentence after that later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding the FHIR-43343 sentence would undo the later applied FHIR-47465 wording for the same authoritative element comment, so an empty no-change audit commit was published.
